issue.title: Defer: Prettier 3 + TypeScript 7 tooling upgrade
issue.body:
## Context

Dependabot PR #481 bundled a `dev-tools` group update that includes **semver-major** bumps:

- `prettier` `2.8.8` → `3.9.6`
- `typescript` `6.0.3` → `7.0.2`

plus non-major `@typescript-eslint/*` and `eslint-plugin-jest` bumps.

That PR was **deferred/closed** during Dependabot queue processing — not safe as a drive-by lockfile merge (CI red; majors need a dedicated migration).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Plan Prettier 2 → 3 migration (config / format churn)
- [ ] Plan TypeScript 6 → 7 upgrade and fix any breaks
- [ ] Optionally land the remaining `dev-tools` minors with those majors, or as a follow-up
- [ ] Consider adding `dependabot.yml` ignore rules for `prettier` / `typescript` semver-major until this ticket is ready (so Dependabot does not reopen the same group)

## Refs

- Closed bot: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/481
